chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
Do not perform sajdah upon pitch, nor upon al-qufr, nor upon saruj.

key_terms.الصَّارُوجِ: saruj, a plaster-like construction material prohibited here for sajdah
key_terms.الْقُفْرِ: al-qufr, a specified surface or material prohibited here for sajdah
key_terms.الْقِيرِ: pitch or tar, a substance on which sajdah is not permitted here
key_terms.تَسْجُدْ: to perform sajdah, meaning to prostrate in salat (prayer)
key_terms.قَالَ: he said, introducing the matn from the Imam عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: On which materials is sajdah not permitted according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the validity of sajdah surfaces in salat (prayer). Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام forbids performing sajdah on pitch, al-qufr, and saruj, indicating that these materials are not suitable surfaces for prostration.
